title: LuckyMining
description: Spice up your mining sessions with random, configurable rewards from Stone and Deepslate blocks.
body:
### ✨ Features
* **Highly Configurable:** Control the spawn probability and the full list of rewards directly from `config.yml`.
* **Anti-Cheat Protection:** Automatically disables rewards for players in Creative mode or when using a **Silk Touch** pickaxe to prevent exploits.
* **Immersive Effects:** Visual feedback (particles) and sound effects make finding a reward feel special.
* **Easy to Use:** Simply drop it in your plugins folder, configure, and play!
* **Lightweight:** Highly optimized code with no external dependencies required.
